evidence: From Lake Matheson car park, it’s a short walk to the beginning of the track and the suspension bridge over Clearwater Stream.
From here, you can return to the car park or complete Lake Matheson Circuit.
Most people complete Lake Matheson Circuit clockwise, but you can walk it in either direction.
From Reflection Island, it’s 35 min to the car park via the wetland at the eastern end of the lake.

evidence: The gravel path to Jetty Lookout takes you through the magnificent native rainforest of Westland Tai Poutini National Park.
From here, you can return to the car park or complete Lake Matheson Circuit.
